class.name: FoxPhysicsDragger3D
class.brief_description: Manipulates a [RigidBody3D] by applying localized forces and torques to match this node's global position and rotation.

method.name: grab
method.description: Grabs a [RigidBody3D] at a specific global hit point. Optionally pass a [FoxPhysicsDragProfile] to override the default stiffness and damping.

method.name: release
method.description: Releases the currently held [RigidBody3D]. If [param dampen_spin] is [code]true[/code], it will aggressively kill residual angular velocity to prevent unrealistic spinning upon release.

method.name: _apply_positional_force
method.description: Applies a positional force to the grabbed RigidBody3D based on its current position and velocity.

method.name: _apply_rotational_torque
method.description: Applies a rotational torque to the grabbed RigidBody3D based on its current orientation.

members.member: The default strength of the pull if no profile is provided.
